bullets: Biggest FVOA vs Yahoo fight this week is Jibreel, who is 8-2 and in 2nd place but only the 8th strongest team, scoring about 2% below the league average. FVOA still gives him ~91% to make playoffs because 8-2 is 8-2, and the schedule luck label says lucky. Next week he's a 45% underdog to Michael.

Scott has the strongest team (FVOA 12.3) and the best strength of record, yet sits 4th at 6-4. He has the hardest schedule in the league and the schedule luck label says unlucky. He also leads the league with 397 points left on his bench this season, so he's not entirely blameless. He is still ~88% to make playoffs and a 57% favorite over Todd, who is 3rd at 7-3 on below-average scoring (about 3% under) and is the overrated one in that matchup.

Manager-Less is 2-8, 10th in the standings and 0% to make playoffs, but is the 5th strongest team. Schedule luck says unlucky: 99% of random schedules would have left them ranked higher. Then they left 78.4 points on the bench this week, the most in the league, including a 40.4-point Dal at QB that sat behind NE's 3.0. Fitting for a team called Manager-Less.

Marty has the biggest game of the week. Against Bobby, a pure coin flip, a win takes his playoff odds from ~39% to ~66% and a loss drops them to ~15%. He's 6-4 with scoring about 4% under the average, so FVOA calls his record overrated. He fell ~20 points in playoff odds this week.

Michael is 3-7 but the 3rd strongest team in the league, and scoring about 2% above average backs that up. He has left just 5 points on the bench all week, the fewest in the league, so he's doing everything right except winning. He's only ~6% to make playoffs, and the schedule luck label says unlucky.
commish_corner: Commish has the 2nd best strength of record but the weakest team in FVOA, with scoring about 12% below the league average and the easiest schedule in the league. The schedule luck label says lucky, with ~88% of random schedules leaving him ranked lower than 6th. He's at ~0.4% to make playoffs, and KC's 40.4 points at QB sat on his bench behind Hou's 21.4, part of 33.6 points left this week. He's a 41% underdog to Manager-Less next week.
